context: Two friends talk casually with lots of subtle modal markers
purpose: Teach: いかにも/網/打っ/満ち/回避/っぱなし/じっと/マル

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いてよ。バイト先の店長、いかにも体育会系って感じでさ、毎朝シフト表に赤マルつけて『今日も全力で打って出るぞ』とか言ってんの。
lines.en: Hey, listen. My part-time boss is totally the sporty type, you know — every morning he puts red circles on the shift sheet and goes 'Let's go all out today!'
lines.style: Casual venting with playful exaggerated mimicry

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、なにそれ。じっと見てたら気まずくない？三か月くらい我慢してるんでしょ？
lines.en: Hehe, what's with that? Isn't it awkward if you just stare? You've been putting up with it for like three months, right?
lines.style: Soft teasing affection with gentle curious lilt

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 気まずいっていうか、こっちはずっと笑顔つくりっぱなしで顔が疲れるんだよ。残業もタダ働きさせられそうだし。
lines.en: Awkward isn't the word — I have to keep a smile plastered on the whole time and my face gets tired. And it looks like I'll end up doing unpaid overtime too.
lines.style: Mildly frustrated grumble with rising complaint energy

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわ、それはちょっと回避したい感じだね…。なんか、自分から網に飛び込んじゃってるみたいになってない？
lines.en: Yikes, that's the kind of thing you'd want to dodge… It's like you're jumping into the net yourself, isn't it?
lines.style: Empathetic concern with light playful metaphor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほんとそれ。最初はやる気に満ちてたのに、今じゃ毎朝『行きたくない』って気持ちでいっぱいだよ。
lines.en: Seriously. At first I was full of motivation, but now every morning I'm just full of 'I don't wanna go'.
lines.style: Resigned tone with self-deprecating casual humor

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: んー、思いきって辞めちゃうのもアリじゃない？無理して続けるのが偉いとは限らないよ？
lines.en: Hmm, maybe just boldly quitting is an option too? Pushing through isn't always the admirable choice, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion with caring modal softness

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だよね…ちょっと考えてみるわ。ありがと、話聞いてくれて。
lines.en: Yeah, you're right… I'll think about it a bit. Thanks for listening.
lines.style: Quieter sincere shift to gratitude and reflection
